full.description: This is a micrograph showing a section of tissue, likely from an endocrine organ such as the pituitary gland stained for iron. The image reveals abundant blue-staining iron deposits within the parenchymal cells. These findings are characteristic of hemochromatosis involving the endocrine system. The heavy iron accumulation demonstrates the systemic nature of the iron overload.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of liver tissue. It shows areas of necrosis with pale, ghost-like hepatocytes and surrounding inflammatory changes. Prussian blue staining may be used here to highlight hemosiderin deposits in macrophages. The histological appearance is characteristic of ischemic or toxic liver injury.
